examples.title: Example 1: Setting a Custom Suffix Icon
examples.description: This example sets a custom suffix icon by configuring suffixIcon.

examples.title: Example 2: Using the Default Suffix Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display the default suffix delete icon by setting allowClose to true.

examples.title: Example 3: Displaying No Suffix Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to hide the default suffix delete icon by setting allowClose to false.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing the Activated State
examples.description: This example shows how to implement the activated state for a chip by configuring activated.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the symbol-type prefix icon of the chip.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing a Mirrored Layout
examples.description: This example shows how to implement a chip mirrored layout by configuring direction.

examples.title: Example 7: Implementing Accessibility for an Image-Type Suffix Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the accessibility feature for a chip with an image-type suffix icon. Clicking the suffix icon triggers the announcement of "icon, button, usage hints."

examples.title: Example 8: Implementing Accessibility for a Symbol-Type Suffix Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the accessibility feature for a chip with a symbol-type suffix icon. Clicking the suffix icon triggers the announcement of "music, button, usage hints."

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing Chip Accessibility
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set accessibility properties for the chip, including different selected state types.
